title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: terminal
text:
terminal
terminal
(definition)
Definition:
The set of points in a plane or
vertices
in a
graph
defining endpoints of a
Steiner tree
.
See also
Steiner point
,
Steiner vertex
.
